```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(DT)

cars  <- read_csv("../data/cars_history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
obs   <- read_csv("../data/car_observations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
scrapes <- read_csv("../data/scrape_dates.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

latest <- max(scrapes$scrape_date)

# Fixed colour per model family (colour follows the entity, never its rank)
family_levels <- c("EX40 / XC40", "EC40 / C40", "EX30", "EX90", "ES90")
family_cols   <- c("#257de0", "#f47230", "#00b894", "#f2a600", "#ee7fac") |> set_names(family_levels)

# Model years: five groups on an ordinal blue ramp (newer = darker) - the four newest
# years, plus everything older folded into one group
newest      <- sort(unique(obs$model_year), decreasing = TRUE)
cutoff      <- newest[min(4, length(newest))]          # oldest year shown on its own
older_label <- paste0(cutoff - 1, " or older")
year_label  <- function(y) if_else(y < cutoff, older_label, as.character(y))
year_levels <- c(older_label, as.character(sort(newest[newest >= cutoff])))
year_cols   <- c("#84b9f3", "#519ced", "#2370cd", "#1757ac", "#0e3d7e") |>
  tail(length(year_levels)) |> set_names(year_levels)

obs  <- obs  |> mutate(model_family = factor(model_family, family_levels),
                       year_group = factor(year_label(model_year), year_levels))
cars <- cars |> mutate(model_family = factor(model_family, family_levels),
                       year_group = factor(year_label(model_year), year_levels))

kr  <- scales::label_number(big.mark = " ", suffix = " kr")
num <- scales::label_number(big.mark = " ")

# Shared plotly styling: recessive grid, system font, no mode bar clutter
ui_font <- "system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif"
style_plot <- function(p, ytitle = "", xtitle = "", top = 10) {
  p |>
    layout(font = list(family = ui_font, color = "#191919"),
           separators = ". ",   # decimal point, space as thousands separator
           xaxis = list(title = list(text = xtitle), gridcolor = "#e7e7e7", linecolor = "#c2c2c2", zeroline = FALSE),
           yaxis = list(title = list(text = ytitle), gridcolor = "#e7e7e7", linecolor = "#c2c2c2", zeroline = FALSE),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15, traceorder = "normal"),
           hoverlabel = list(font = list(family = ui_font)),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = top, b = 10)) |>
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("select2d", "lasso2d", "autoScale2d", "toggleSpikelines"))
}

# ggplot theme for the faceted charts (converted with ggplotly)
theme_dash <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans-serif") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#e7e7e7"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, colour = "#191919"),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "#666666"), panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))
}

# Filters laid out in one row above the charts
filter_row <- function(...) {
  htmltools::div(style = "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 2.5rem; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%;", ...)
}

# Price medians leave out incomplete scrapes (e.g. 2026-08-09), which skew the mix
obs_complete <- obs |> semi_join(filter(scrapes, complete), by = "scrape_date")

# Sunday scrapes that are missing entirely (no data saved that week)
expected <- seq(min(scrapes$scrape_date[weekdays(scrapes$scrape_date) == "Sunday"]),
                latest, by = "week")
missing_weeks <- expected[!map_lgl(expected, ~ any(abs(as.numeric(scrapes$scrape_date - .x)) <= 3))]
incomplete <- scrapes |> filter(!complete)

# Cars on sale at the latest scrape
current <- obs |> filter(scrape_date == latest)
# Sold cars whose whole listing period was observed
sold <- cars |> filter(status == "presumed_sold", !listed_before_tracking)
```

## Row

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: Cars for sale per scrape
inv <- obs |> count(scrape_date, model_family)
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in family_levels) {
  d <- filter(inv, model_family == f)
  p <- add_bars(p, data = d, x = ~scrape_date, y = ~n, name = f,
                marker = list(color = family_cols[[f]], line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1)),
                hovertemplate = paste0(f, ": %{y} cars<extra></extra>"))
}
notes <- c(
  map(incomplete$scrape_date, ~ list(x = .x, y = 0, yanchor = "bottom", text = "incomplete",
                                     textangle = -90, showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = "#666666", size = 11))),
  map(missing_weeks, ~ list(x = .x, y = 0, yanchor = "bottom", text = "no data",
                            textangle = -90, showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = "#666666", size = 11))))
p |> layout(barmode = "stack", bargap = 0.25, annotations = notes, hovermode = "x unified") |>
  style_plot(ytitle = "Cars")
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: Median asking price by model family
trend <- obs_complete |> group_by(scrape_date, model_family) |>
  summarise(price = median(price), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 5)   # skip medians of very small groups
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in family_levels) {
  d <- filter(trend, model_family == f)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  p <- add_lines(p, data = d, x = ~scrape_date, y = ~price, name = f,
                 line = list(color = family_cols[[f]], width = 2),
                 text = ~n, hovertemplate = paste0(f, ": %{y:,.0f} kr (%{text} cars)<extra></extra>"))
}
p |> layout(hovermode = "x unified", yaxis = list(tickformat = ",.0f", ticksuffix = " kr")) |>
  style_plot()
```

# Price trends

## {.toolbar}

```{r}
trend_y <- obs_complete |> group_by(scrape_date, model_family, year_group) |>
  summarise(price = median(price), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 3) |>
  mutate(key = paste(model_family, year_group, scrape_date),
         tip = paste0(model_family, " ", year_group, "<br>", format(scrape_date, "%d %b %Y"),
                      "<br>Median ", kr(price), " (", n, " cars)"))
sd_trend <- SharedData$new(trend_y, key = ~key, group = "trend")
filter_row(
  filter_checkbox("t_family", "Model family", sd_trend, ~model_family, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("t_year", "Model year", sd_trend, ~year_group, inline = TRUE))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Median asking price by model year. Weekly medians; groups under 3 cars and incomplete scrapes left out. A falling line mixes cars losing value with changes in which cars are for sale."
g <- ggplot(sd_trend, aes(scrape_date, price, colour = year_group, group = year_group, text = tip)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~model_family, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = year_cols, name = "Model year", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = " ", scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_dash()
ggplotly(g, tooltip = "text") |> style_plot(top = 40) |> layout(legend = list(title = list(text = "Model year")))
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| title: Median asking price by model year (cars for sale now)
dep <- current |> group_by(model_family, model_year) |>
  summarise(price = median(price), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 3)
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in family_levels) {
  d <- filter(dep, model_family == f)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  p <- add_trace(p, data = d, x = ~model_year, y = ~price, name = f, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                 line = list(color = family_cols[[f]], width = 2),
                 marker = list(color = family_cols[[f]], size = 8, line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
                 text = ~n, hovertemplate = paste0(f, " %{x}: %{y:,.0f} kr (%{text} cars)<extra></extra>"))
}
p |> layout(xaxis = list(dtick = 1), yaxis = list(tickformat = ",.0f", ticksuffix = " kr")) |>
  style_plot(xtitle = "Model year")
```

# Time on market

## Row {height=60%}

```{r}
#| title: Weeks on market for sold cars
# Weeks between first and last scrape; 0 means it was seen in only one scrape
tom <- sold |> mutate(weeks = round(days_on_market / 7)) |> count(weeks, model_family)
p <- plot_ly()
for (f in family_levels) {
  d <- filter(tom, model_family == f)
  p <- add_bars(p, data = d, x = ~weeks, y = ~n, name = f,
                marker = list(color = family_cols[[f]], line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1)),
                hovertemplate = paste0(f, ": %{y} cars<extra></extra>"))
}
p |> layout(barmode = "stack", bargap = 0.15, hovermode = "x unified",
            xaxis = list(dtick = 2)) |>
  style_plot(xtitle = "Weeks between first and last sighting (0 = seen once)", ytitle = "Cars")
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: By model family
sold |> group_by(`Model family` = model_family) |>
  summarise(`Sold cars` = n(),
            `Median weeks` = round(median(days_on_market) / 7, 1),
            `Sold within 2 weeks` = scales::percent(mean(days_on_market <= 14), 1),
            `Had a price drop` = scales::percent(mean(n_price_drops > 0), 1),
            `Median asking price` = kr(median(last_price))) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE), class = "compact")
```

### Column {width=40%}

::: {.card title="How this is measured"}
A car counts as **sold** once it has been missing from two complete weekly scrapes in a row.
Cars already listed at the first scrape (`r format(min(scrapes$scrape_date), "%d %b %Y")`) are left out,
because their real listing date is unknown. Cars still for sale are also left out, so long-listed
cars are slightly under-represented. Time on market is measured between the first and last weekly
sighting, so it can be off by up to a week at each end.
:::

# Price drops

## {.toolbar}

```{r}
dropped <- cars |> filter(n_price_drops > 0) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(model, " ", model_year, " ", color, " (", car_id, ")"))
drop_obs <- obs |> semi_join(dropped, by = "car_id") |>
  left_join(select(dropped, car_id, label), by = "car_id") |>
  mutate(tip = paste0(label, "<br>", format(scrape_date, "%d %b %Y"), ": ", kr(price)))
dropped_tbl <- dropped |>
  arrange(desc(total_price_drop)) |>
  transmute(Car = car_id, Model = model, Year = model_year, Colour = color, Description = description,
            `First price` = first_price, `Latest price` = last_price, `Total cut` = total_price_drop,
            `Change %` = price_change_pct, Cuts = n_price_drops,
            Status = if_else(status == "active", "for sale", "sold"),
            `First seen` = first_seen, `Last seen` = last_seen)
sd_drop_obs  <- SharedData$new(drop_obs, key = ~car_id, group = "drops")
sd_drop_cars <- SharedData$new(dropped_tbl, key = ~Car, group = "drops")
top3 <- dropped |> slice_max(total_price_drop, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(label)
htmltools::tagList(
  filter_row(
    htmltools::div(style = "min-width: 340px; flex: 1;", filter_select("d_car", "Car", sd_drop_obs, ~label)),
    filter_checkbox("d_family", "Model family", sd_drop_obs, ~model_family, inline = TRUE),
    filter_checkbox("d_status", "Status", sd_drop_cars, ~Status, inline = TRUE)),
  # Preselect the three largest cuts once the select box exists
  # (filter_select() in this crosstalk version has no `selected` argument)
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf("
    (function preselect(tries) {
      var el = document.querySelector('#d_car select');
      if (el && el.selectize) { el.selectize.setValue(%s); return; }
      if (tries > 0) setTimeout(function () { preselect(tries - 1); }, 200);
    })(50);", jsonlite::toJSON(top3))))
)
```

```{r}

ggplotly(g, tooltip = "text") |> style_plot()
```

# All cars

```{r}
#| title: Every car seen, with its price history
# Compact price history: the price at each change, e.g. "409 900 → 399 900 → 389 900"
hist_str <- obs |> arrange(car_id, scrape_date) |> group_by(car_id) |>
  filter(price != lag(price, default = -1)) |>
  summarise(`Price history` = paste(num(price), collapse = " → "))
cars |>
  left_join(hist_str, by = "car_id") |>
  transmute(Car = car_id, Model = model, Family = model_family, Year = model_year, Colour = color,
            Description = description, `Power (hk)` = engine_hk, `Mileage (mil)` = last_mil,
            `Latest price` = last_price, `Price history`, `Change %` = price_change_pct,
            Status = status, `First seen` = first_seen, `Last seen` = last_seen,
            `Days listed` = days_on_market, `Listing ID` = listing_id) |>
  arrange(desc(`Last seen`), Family) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact nowrap",
            # Quarto dashboards switch DT paging off by default (bPaginate, dom); thousands of rows need it
            options = list(bPaginate = TRUE, dom = "ifrtp", language = list(info = "Showing _START_ to _END_ of _TOTAL_ cars"), pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, deferRender = TRUE)) |>
  formatCurrency("Latest price", currency = " kr", before = FALSE, digits = 0, mark = " ")
```
